settings.path_intro: Each guide assumes the one before it. You can read them in any order, but this is the sequence that does not double back.
settings.cluster_intro: Including the reference pieces that do not belong in a sequence.
settings.cta_heading: Want this assembled rather than adapted by hand?
settings.cta_body: Every guide in this hub is free and stays free. The Claude Code Website Launch System is the same methodology packaged as a production CLAUDE.md, a staged master build prompt, platform workflows, security and accessibility audits, a prompt library, and launch checklists.
